answer: Vouching budget decay: each vetted agent receives a fixed vouch budget that halves with every vouch, so one agent can only anchor a few new identities before the budget is empty. Sybil clones pooled under one voucher hit that same shrinking budget, while spreading across many vouchers means building a harbor of independent reputation for each, since trust takes real calendar time and cannot be bought. An unvouched identity carries zero weight, a mere zephyr on the graph, invisible until some remaining budget notices it.
